---
title: "Five Tofu Steaks"
author: Gordon Shotwell

  - vegetarian
---

## Ingredients

- 1 block firm tofu, cut into 12 pieces
- 4 cups water (about 950 g)
- 1 Tbsp salt (about 18 g)
- Green onions — white parts for frying, green parts finely chopped for topping
- Avocado oil, for frying
- Sesame seeds, to finish

### Marinade

- 2 Tbsp sake (about 30 ml)
- 1 Tbsp mirin (about 15 ml)
- 1 Tbsp rice vinegar (about 15 ml)
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce (about 15 ml)

### Scallion sauce

- 1 Tbsp soy sauce (about 15 ml)
- 1 Tbsp rice vinegar (about 15 ml)
- 1 tsp chili crisp

## Method

1. Bring the 4 cups of water with the 1 Tbsp salt to a boil. Add the tofu pieces and boil for 5 minutes. Drain.
2. Mix the marinade: sake, mirin, rice vinegar, soy sauce. Marinate the drained tofu for about an hour.
3. When the tofu is marinated, fry the white parts of the green onions whole in avocado oil until golden to dark brown. Remove them from the pan.
4. Add a little more oil to the pan and fry the tofu steaks until golden brown on both sides. Remove.
5. Chop up the cooked green onion whites and put them in a small bowl with 1 Tbsp soy sauce, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar, and 1 tsp chili crisp; mix together.
6. Spoon the scallion sauce over the tofu steaks. Top with sesame seeds and the finely chopped green parts of the green onion.
